# Compositor

public static class Compositor

Stacks finished layer images into one asset.

## Methods

### Composite(Dimensions, IReadOnlyList&lt;Image&lt;Rgba32&gt;&gt;, Configuration?) { #m-composite-nfty-core-model-dimensions-system-collection-cb4a2f }

```csharp
public static Image<Rgba32> Composite(Dimensions canvas, IReadOnlyList<Image<Rgba32>> layersBottomToTop, Configuration? configuration = null);
```

Composites layers bottom-to-top onto a transparent canvas.

**Parameters**

- `canvas` (`Dimensions`) - The output size; every layer must match it.
- `layersBottomToTop` (`IReadOnlyList<Image<Rgba32>>`) - Layer images in draw order.
- `configuration` (`Configuration?`) - The ImageSharp configuration to draw under, to cap its own row-parallelism; null uses `Default`. Never changes the pixels.

**Returns.** The composited asset; the caller owns it.
